gaps.requirement: UC11-1, DESC11-3, SCOPE11-5: Collaborative departmental agents negotiating schedules
gaps.evidence: lib/pb4t.mjs runs centralized boundedSearch and constructs negotiation entries only after finding a solution. Departments supply data and ordering, but no departmental proposal/response behavior participates in negotiation. domain.test.mjs asserts the resulting summary, not agent collaboration.
gaps.fix: Implement departmental proposal and counterproposal handlers participating in shared-constraint coordination. Test changed departmental preferences, rejected proposals, backtracking and impossible-case termination using actual exchange traces.

gaps.requirement: UC11-1, SCH-04, SCOPE11-6: Preserve mandated training periodicities
gaps.evidence: lib/pb4t.mjs checks only manually enumerated occurrences; referenceIntervalMinutes never determines obligations. Removing both a required occurrence and its drill leaves no mechanism to detect the omission. Deadline tests in domain.test.mjs do not establish recurrence expansion.
gaps.fix: Implement a clearly labeled synthetic recurrence-rule model that derives required occurrences from cadence and completion history, detects omitted training, and feeds scheduling. Test changed cadence, multiple weekly occurrences, boundary deadlines and impossible coverage; retain authoritative SFTRM mapping as a human review step.

gaps.evidence: public/app.js assigns the same background color to every positive daily duty load; .heat in public/styles.css only arranges numeric spans. Different positive loads therefore have identical intensity despite public/index.html stating darker cells mean more minutes.
gaps.fix: Map computed load magnitudes to a documented color scale with a legend and accessible numeric values. Test zero, low and high loads, including changed synthetic inputs, and assert distinct ordered intensities.
